methodology.value: Unweighted mean over all 370 documents; any failed document contributes zero precision/recall/F1.
methodology.grounding: Official unchanged EvaluationRunner macro aggregation: successful documents contribute only when they emit the corresponding grounding metric. Every failed extraction adds one zero to each pipeline-observed grounding metric, regardless of that failed document's annotation coverage. Successful grounded_incomplete cases remain excluded. Reported denominators include all failed documents.
methodology.cost: Mean of each document's reported API cost divided by its page count; not total cost divided by total pages. Excludes local compute and prior development experiments. Unresolved reservations may exceed actual charges.
methodology.latency: Core inference_completed_at minus started_at where available: warm cached LiteParse parsing plus inference; excludes citation construction and evaluation. Missing timestamps excluded from latency mean only. Leaderboard latency columns intentionally blank; cold end-to-end latency not measured.
methodology.overlap: Full 370 includes 12 development documents. Prior Luna study saw designated holdout labels; holdout is for Jev selection, not previously unseen in the broader project.
methodology.operational_budget_continuation: Only shared-budget-interrupted documents were eligible. The cumulative study cap increased from $9.00 to $9.75 because development consumed the shared ledger. Exact ordered archived request hashes and successful answers were replayed before any new request; successful document outputs were never rerolled. Original charges and failed-request reservations remain counted once, with new charges added. Resume receives a fresh 1800-second allowance, while the combined original-plus-new attempt limit remains 2000. The standalone framework's default $9 budget and frozen inference code are unchanged. Resumed core latency is unavailable.

freeze.selection: Four rounds of three variants on 12 development documents, followed by source/schema-only router synthesis. No subsequent tuning.

dataset_verification.canonical_json_hash_format: SHA256 UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon)); corpus hash applies same encoding to sorted document-path-to-component-hash mapping

pdf.note: All local PDFs have SHA256s in local_corpus_sha256. Remote LFS subset has272 SHA256 entries; remaining98 ordinary Git files were checked against Git blob SHA1 metadata without PDF downloads.

dataset_verification.label_handling: Expected outputs, field rules, and row identities were compared only as canonical JSON hashes; no label values were printed or used for inference. Downloaded metadata and three JSONL files only; local dataset unchanged.
